To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the Two-Phase query translation method is effective in Arabic-English CL IR, (2) the Every-Match and First-Match query translation methods are less effective than Two-Phase, and (3) the quality of MT-based Arabic-English CL I R improves when using long queries.

the Every-Match method yields ambiguous translation, the First-Match method disambiguates the translation, and the Two-Phase translation method is effective for Arabic-English Cross-Language Information Retrievals.

the Two-Phase query translation method is the most effective method of translating queries in the Arabic-English CL-IR, and that MT-based CLIR is effective for short queries but not effective for medium and long queries.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of machine readable dictionaries and machine translation for cross-language information retrieval.
the development of effective query translation techniques for Arabic-English cross-language information retrieval.
the use of machine-readable dictionaries and MT in Arabic-English CL IR.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the MT-based CLI R is a promising approach for Arabic-English retrieval.
the Two-Phase translation method yields the best retrieval performance for Arabic-English cross-language retrieval.
the use of a bilingual dictionary is a viable and effective approach for CLIR.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of MT and MRDs can improve the effectiveness of CLIR.
a good retrieval effectiveness can achieved without complex resources for Arabic-English cross-language information retrieval using the Two-Phrase method.
the Two-Phase query translation method yields better results than the Every-Match and the First-Match methods, and that the MT-based CL IR method yields better results for longer queries.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Two-Phase approach can yield effective Arabic-English CL-IR with no complex resources.
the use of a bilingual dictionary for CLIR can yield effective retrieval without the use of complex resources such as MT.
a simple method can be used effectively for Arabic-English cross-language information retrieval.
